title: 数据质量体检清单：六项必查
expected_output:
原始形状 : (6, 5)

=== 1) 完整性: 每列缺失率 ===
  id       缺失率=0.00%
  city     缺失率=0.00%
  amount   缺失率=16.67%
  qty      缺失率=0.00%
  date     缺失率=0.00%

=== 2) 唯一性 ===
  完全重复行 : 0
  id 唯一值数 : 5 | 行数 : 6 -> id 重复: True

=== 3) 有效性: 类型检查 ===
  id       dtype=int64      例=np.int64(1)
  city     dtype=str        例='北京'
  amount   dtype=float64    例=np.float64(120.0)
  qty      dtype=str        例='3'
  date     dtype=str        例='2026-01-03'

=== 4) 一致性: 同义异名 / 空白 ===
  原始取值 : ['北京', '北京市', '上海 ', '上海', '广州', '广州']
  归一取值 : ['北京', '北京', '上海', '上海', '广州', '广州']
  归一后唯一值数 : 3 (归一前 5 )

=== 5) 准确性: 越界与非法 ===
  amount < 0 : 1 -> 金额不应为负
  格式不统一或非法日期 : 2

=== 6) 处置方案(留痕: 新增列不覆盖) ===
 id city_clean  amount_clean  qty_clean date_clean
  1         北京         120.0          3 2026-01-03
  2         北京          98.5          2        NaT
  3         上海           NaN          5 2026-01-06
  4         上海           NaN          1 2026-01-06
  5         广州          88.0          4        NaT

清洗后行数 : 5 | 负值金额剩余 : 0
原则: 原始列保留, 清洗结果写新列; 每一步都能回溯
code:
# 数据质量体检清单: 六项必查
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

raw = pd.DataFrame({
    "id":       [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5],
    "city":     ["北京", "北京市", "上海 ", "上海", "广州", "广州"],
    "amount":   [120.0, 98.5, -30.0, np.nan, 88.0, 88.0],
    "qty":      ["3", "2", "5", "1", "4", "4"],
    "date":     ["2026-01-03", "2026/1/5", "2026-01-06", "2026-01-06", "2026-02-30", "2026-01-10"],
})

print("原始形状 :", raw.shape)
print("")
print("=== 1) 完整性: 每列缺失率 ===")
miss = raw.isna().mean().round(4)
for c in raw.columns:
    print("  %-8s 缺失率=%.2f%%" % (c, miss[c] * 100))

print("")
print("=== 2) 唯一性 ===")
print("  完全重复行 :", int(raw.duplicated().sum()))
n_id = raw["id"].nunique()
print("  id 唯一值数 :", n_id, "| 行数 :", len(raw), "-> id 重复:", n_id < len(raw))

print("")
print("=== 3) 有效性: 类型检查 ===")
for c in raw.columns:
    print("  %-8s dtype=%-10s 例=%r" % (c, str(raw[c].dtype), raw[c].iloc[0]))

print("")
print("=== 4) 一致性: 同义异名 / 空白 ===")
cities = raw["city"].tolist()
norm = raw["city"].str.strip().replace({"北京市": "北京"})
print("  原始取值 :", cities)
print("  归一取值 :", norm.tolist())
print("  归一后唯一值数 :", norm.nunique(), "(归一前", raw["city"].nunique(), ")")

print("")
print("=== 5) 准确性: 越界与非法 ===")
print("  amount < 0 :", int((raw["amount"] < 0).sum()), "-> 金额不应为负")
bad_date = raw["date"].str.contains(r"/") | pd.to_datetime(raw["date"], errors="coerce").isna()
print("  格式不统一或非法日期 :", int(bad_date.sum()))

print("")
print("=== 6) 处置方案(留痕: 新增列不覆盖) ===")
clean = raw.copy()
clean["city_clean"] = clean["city"].str.strip().replace({"北京市": "北京"})
clean["qty_clean"] = pd.to_numeric(clean["qty"], errors="coerce")
clean["amount_clean"] = clean["amount"].where(clean["amount"] >= 0)   # 负值置缺失
clean["date_clean"] = pd.to_datetime(clean["date"], errors="coerce")
clean = clean.drop_duplicates(subset=["id"], keep="first")
print(clean[["id", "city_clean", "amount_clean", "qty_clean", "date_clean"]].to_string(index=False))
print("")
print("清洗后行数 :", len(clean), "| 负值金额剩余 :", int((clean["amount_clean"] < 0).sum()))
print("原则: 原始列保留, 清洗结果写新列; 每一步都能回溯")
